declaredIdentity: Shared tenant+id address, foreign sentinels, RequestId creation identity. Semantic asset-list equality for immediate create retry but compares current state after revisions. Expected revision/physical OCC; no selected prior operation recognition.
invariant: One tenant inventory identity has one record kind; flow endpoint/asset scope and encryption or approved-exception terms must match highest admitted carried classification, and effective date never moves backward.
boundaryRationale: Shared type exclusion must remain in one physical slot. Complete carried-asset relation is evidence for one atomic encryption rule; asset identity/lifecycle remains separate. No reason for all flows to share a revision.
identityReadingRule: selectedIdentitySummary and exact selectedCommandContracts define intended identity. baselineIdentityObservation/declaredIdentity retain older source observations only, including old replay defects; they are not target behavior or authorization to change an occupied key.

logicalIdentity.rule: caller-supplied immutable creation identity: an exact retry with the same id and authored intent returns the original result; the same id with changed intent is refused; a different id is a different record
CommandId binds one immutable authored intent to the exact owner identity and expected revision: an exact retry returns the original result, a changed intent under the same CommandId is refused

baselineIdentityObservation: Shared tenant+id address, foreign sentinels, RequestId creation identity. Semantic asset-list equality for immediate create retry but compares current state after revisions. Expected revision/physical OCC; no selected prior operation recognition.
identityContractRule: Existing published owner identity/IdFor remains stable. Required typed creation/operation identity and tenant/program/source scope come from the selected signature/protocol references; no context.RequestId minting fallback or guessed new stream key.
selectedIdentityClarification: Tenant + caller DataFlowId under the preserved shared technology-inventory address/sentinel scheme.
selectedIdentitySummary: Tenant + caller DataFlowId under the preserved shared technology-inventory address/sentinel scheme.
selectedReplayRule: Current required authorization precedes replay; exact authorized retries resolve the original accepted result using the selected logical identity and immutable actor/intent/source binding. Fresh mutable feasibility, clock selection and body preparation cannot replace that original result. Expected revision is concurrency precondition, not a new identity.

productRules.rule: A DataFlow runs from a service or system instance to a data store or external party, carries one or more information assets, a purpose, and encrypted_in_transit and encrypted_at_rest flags, and is effective-dated and versioned.
A DataFlow is invalid when any carried information asset is confidential or restricted and either encryption flag is false, unless an approved exception is referenced.

decides: Requires the flow to run from a service or system instance to a data store or external party, carry one or more information assets, a purpose, and explicit encrypted_in_transit and encrypted_at_rest flags, and be effective-dated and versioned.
